presets.about: Wrapped up against the wind, talking through a thick wool scarf.

presets.name: Mumbling to yourself
presets.about: Thinking out loud under your breath, off to one side.

presets.name: Leaning in to whisper
presets.about: A secret whispered right beside your left ear; best on headphones.

presets.name: Chatting at a coffee shop
presets.about: Talking over cups and chatter at a busy coffee shop table.

presets.name: Late-night kitchen chat
presets.about: A hushed voice in a dark kitchen, the fridge humming beside you.

presets.name: On the porch, summer night
presets.about: Sitting out on a warm night while the crickets sing.

presets.name: Rainy day by the window
presets.about: A cosy living room while rain taps on the glass.

presets.name: Cosy by the fireplace
presets.about: A warm, close voice beside a crackling log fire.

presets.name: Down the school hallway
presets.about: Talking between classes, lockers slamming and kids everywhere.

presets.name: At the laundromat
presets.about: Chatting by the dryers while the machines tumble and slosh.

presets.name: Walk in the park
presets.about: Strolling under the trees on a spring morning full of birdsong.

presets.name: Morning on the farm
presets.about: Calling out across the farmyard as the roosters crow.

presets.name: Busy office desk
presets.about: Talking at your desk while keyboards clatter and phones ring.

presets.name: Waiting at the bus stop
presets.about: A voice on a busy corner while cars swish past.

presets.name: Windows down on the highway
presets.about: Shouting over the wind in a car with every window open.

presets.name: Talking through your teeth
presets.about: Jaw clenched tight, every word squeezed out between your teeth.

presets.name: Angry shout
presets.about: Red-faced and yelling, the voice straining and cracking at the top.

presets.name: Whiny and pleading
presets.about: A high, nasal, drawn-out plea, the voice sliding around every word.

presets.name: Lifting something heavy
presets.about: Talking mid-heave, strained and squeezed, the voice shaking with effort.

presets.name: Whispering in the library
presets.about: A careful whisper between the shelves, pages turning and a clock ticking nearby.

presets.name: Calling orders in a kitchen
presets.about: Shouting orders over sizzling pans and clattering knives in a busy restaurant kitchen.

presets.name: Parked in the rain
presets.about: Sitting in a parked car while rain drums on the roof and the wipers tick.

presets.name: Tiny fairy with sparkles
presets.about: A thumb-sized fairy whose every word leaves glittering notes ringing in the air.

presets.name: Giggling pixie
presets.about: A mischievous pixie who trips over her own giggles and bounces from ear to ear.

presets.name: Fairy inside a flower
presets.about: A fairy calling from inside a bluebell, ringing small and close in a dawn meadow.

presets.name: Fairy with buzzing wings
presets.about: A fairy hovering by your ears, her tiny wings humming through every word.

presets.name: Fairy ring dance
presets.about: A ring of little fairies all speaking at once as they dance in a sunny wood.

presets.name: Pixie dust trail
presets.about: A pixie voice that sheds a trail of tiny glittering grains as it flits past.

presets.name: Fairy queen's court
presets.about: The fairy queen speaks with a shining echo of herself an octave above, in a great hall.

presets.name: Wisp light over the marsh
presets.about: A breathy little marsh light drifting around you, luring you deeper into the swamp.

presets.name: Fairy bell voice
presets.about: Each fairy word strikes a little music box tune that rings on in a quick echo.

presets.name: Sprite in a dewdrop
presets.about: A water sprite no bigger than a bead, her voice swirling inside a round drop of dew.

presets.name: Wood elf among the trees
presets.about: A light, clear elf voice with a soft shimmer, out among rustling trees.

presets.name: High elf in a moonlit hall
presets.about: A noble elf whose words rise into a fifth above, ringing round a tall hall.

presets.name: Dwarf in the mines
presets.about: A gruff, gravelly dwarf booming down a dripping mine tunnel.

presets.name: Dwarf at the forge
presets.about: A hot, saturated dwarf voice shouting over the roaring forge fire.

presets.name: Garden gnome
presets.about: A small, old, slightly shaky gnome chatting in a summer garden.

presets.name: Gnome under a mushroom
presets.about: A tiny gnome tucked under a toadstool cap, close and boxy and a bit stuffy.

presets.name: Elven song across the valley
presets.about: Your speech gently tuned to a minor key with a fifth above, echoing across a valley.

presets.name: Dark elf's whisper
presets.about: A cold whisper just behind your right shoulder, with backwards echoes creeping in.

presets.name: Ancient talking tree
presets.about: A slow, deep, woody voice creaking out of an old oak while the wind moves its leaves.

presets.name: Enchanted forest spirit
presets.about: An airy spirit circling slowly among birdsong, half breath and half shining voice.

presets.name: Weeping willow by the river
presets.about: A sad, soft tree voice that trails into a hazy smear beside a flowing river.

presets.name: Nymph of the spring
presets.about: A bright water nymph whose voice ripples like the creek she lives in.

presets.name: Unicorn in a moonlit glade
presets.about: A gentle glassy voice glowing with a fifth above it, with owls calling in the night woods.

presets.name: Mushroom circle voices
presets.about: Four odd little forest folk, high and low, all answering you from the undergrowth.

presets.name: Moss-covered standing stone
presets.about: A very old stone in a clearing speaking low and muffled, as if through moss.

presets.name: Wizard's echoing command
presets.about: A deep commanding wizard whose words bounce back again and again around a great hall.

presets.name: Wizard atop the tower
presets.about: A wizard calling down a ringing stone stairwell while the wind howls at the windows.

presets.name: Apprentice spell gone wrong
presets.about: A spell backfires: the voice shoots up an octave while it sputters and rings like metal.

presets.name: Sorceress in her chamber
presets.about: A silky, hazy sorceress voice, slowly swirling, with a glowing fifth in the air.

presets.name: Witch over a bubbling cauldron
presets.about: A cackling, crackly witch voice that gurgles as the brew bubbles beside her.

presets.name: Ancient archmage
presets.about: A towering old mage, an octave below and a faint octave above, filling a stone cathedral.

presets.name: Whispering spellbook
presets.about: An old book reading itself aloud in a hushed library, whisper over a low shadow voice.

presets.name: Staff of thunder
presets.about: A wizard's voice poured into rolling thunder, with a real storm raging around.

presets.name: Crystal staff incantation
presets.about: A chant that rings through a crystal staff, the bright notes hanging on like ice.

presets.name: Wizards' duel
presets.about: Two rival wizards made from you, one low and one high, trading words across a hall.

presets.name: Temple oracle
presets.about: An oracle speaking in octaves, her words swelling up out of the temple before she says them.

presets.name: Voice from a crystal ball
presets.about: A small voice trapped inside a glass orb, ringing and swirling as the mist turns.

presets.name: Talking mirror on the wall
presets.about: A glassy, ringing mirror voice that answers with a backwards shadow of each word.

presets.name: Fortune teller's tent
presets.about: A low, mysterious reader of fortunes in a draped tent, the fair going on outside.

presets.name: Seer lost in a vision
presets.about: A seer slowly sinking into a trance, the words smearing and sliding lower as she goes.

presets.name: Prophecy in the mist
presets.about: A crowd of whispering seers repeating the prophecy all around you in a misty hall.

presets.name: Voice in the wishing well
presets.about: The well answers your wish from far down its round stone shaft, dripping and echoing.

presets.name: Scrying pool
presets.about: A face in the still water speaks up through ripples, rising into a shimmer.

presets.name: Riddling stone guardian
presets.about: A huge stone guardian at the gate, slow and grinding, its riddle rolling round a canyon.

presets.name: Genie inside the lamp
presets.about: A big voice squeezed inside a little brass lamp, hollow and ringing and swirling.

presets.name: Genie bursting free
presets.about: The genie swells out of the lamp, growing huge and deep as the words go on.

presets.name: Spirit of curling smoke
presets.about: A drifting smoke spirit, hazy and breathy, curling slowly around your head.

presets.name: Fire spirit
presets.about: A voice half made of flame, hot and crackling, rising out of a roaring bonfire.

presets.name: Wind spirit
presets.about: Your words spoken by the wind itself, sweeping from one ear to the other.

presets.name: Earth spirit under the hill
presets.about: A rumbling voice from deep inside the ground, rolling like distant thunder.

presets.name: Frost spirit
presets.about: An icy spirit whose voice freezes into glittering crystals in a snowstorm.

presets.name: Lightning spirit
presets.about: A buzzing, sizzling electric spirit with a spiral of metal echoes, thunder all around.

presets.name: Spirit of the sea
presets.about: Your words carried on the ocean waves, rolling in and fizzing back across the sand.

presets.name: Angelic choir
presets.about: A full choir of you singing on a chord, rising into a bright octave halo.

presets.name: Heavenly messenger
presets.about: A bright, wide messenger from above, every word blooming into a fifth and an octave.

presets.name: Voice from above the clouds
presets.about: A voice floating high over your head and far away, with a faint octave glow and the wind up there.

presets.name: Harp of the heavens
presets.about: Every word plucks a high golden harp chord that rings up into the sky.

presets.name: At the golden gates
presets.about: A gatekeeper's voice ringing like a great bell, with a fifth above, in a vast cathedral.

presets.name: Guardian angel at your shoulder
presets.about: A soft, warm, breathy voice just above your right shoulder, glowing gently.

presets.name: Celestial herald
presets.about: A herald in octaves announcing from the stars, each word echoing up two octaves.

presets.name: Choir of light
presets.about: Your words tuned into a glowing major chord, shimmering and wide like sunlight.

presets.name: Sky temple bells
presets.about: Your voice rung on temple bells high on a windy mountain.

presets.name: Underworld guide
presets.about: A hollow guide leading you down through the caves, the dark rushing up before each word.

presets.name: Ferryman of the dark river
presets.about: A slow, deep boatman drawling his toll in a long tunnel over black flowing water.

presets.name: Cursed voice
presets.about: A voice split into a low and a high copy, sliding out of tune and dropping out in places.

presets.name: Cursed treasure chest
presets.about: A warped, muttering curse locked inside a wooden treasure chest, knocking to get out.

presets.name: Voice from the shadow realm
presets.about: Only the breathy shadow of a voice comes through, smeared into an endless dark space.

presets.name: Bone king in his crypt
presets.about: A thin, rattling skeleton king holding court in a stone crypt where chains shift.

presets.name: Turning to stone
presets.about: A curse takes hold: the voice goes flat and frozen, then grinds slowly to a stop.

presets.name: Three-headed gate hound
presets.about: Three snarling heads of one great hound, all speaking your words a little apart.

presets.name: Dragon's whisper
presets.about: A huge dragon breathing its words right into your ear, smoke and embers crackling.

presets.name: Dragon on its gold hoard
presets.about: An enormous rumbling dragon voice filling a cavern piled high with ringing gold.

presets.name: Giant's thought
presets.about: A giant thinking to itself, slow and deep and dark, heard from inside its huge head.

presets.name: Sleeping giant mumbling
presets.about: A colossal sleeper mumbling in a dream, very slow and very low, muffled by the hillside.

presets.name: Cloud giant far away
presets.about: A giant calling from a distant mountain, the words echoing off peak after peak.

presets.name: Sea serpent rising
presets.about: A hissing serpent voice surfacing from under the water as the sea breaks around it.

presets.name: Wyvern screeching overhead
presets.about: A rasping winged beast screeching as it swoops over your head and away.

presets.name: Baby dragon
presets.about: A cute little dragon with a crackly growl it is very proud of, by a small campfire.

presets.name: Stone golem
presets.about: A slab of living rock grinding out every word, crunchy and stiff, in a quarry.

presets.name: Casting a spell
presets.about: Words wrapped in backwards echoes and a rising shimmer, sparkling as the spell takes hold.

presets.name: Drinking a shrinking potion
presets.about: One sip and you shrink as you talk, ending as a tiny squeak.

presets.name: Drinking a growing potion
presets.about: One sip and you grow as you talk, ending as a towering giant in a big hall.

presets.name: Invisible friend circling you
presets.about: Someone you cannot see, breathy and quick, zipping round and round your head.

presets.name: Time freeze spell
presets.about: Time stops on every syllable, the frozen sounds hanging and swirling in the air.

presets.name: Teleporting spell
presets.about: Each phrase blinks to the other ear with a metallic zap and a sparkling trail.

presets.name: Charm spell, sweet and dreamy
presets.about: A honeyed, wavering voice wrapped in a soft glowing chorus.

presets.name: Falling under a sleep spell
presets.about: Your voice slows and sinks as the spell works, drifting off into a soft haze.

presets.name: Glowing rune echo
presets.about: Your words tuned to a hovering chord that echoes on the beat, like a rune humming.

presets.name: Spell turns you into a frog
presets.about: Mid-sentence the spell lands and your voice sinks into a gargling croak.

presets.name: Arriving through time
presets.about: A time traveller spinning up out of the whirl, the voice winding up to speed with a whoosh.

presets.name: Message from the far future
presets.about: A voice reaching back through the ages, wobbling, slipping and smeared by time.

presets.name: Dream voice
presets.about: A soft, swaying voice from inside a dream, dark and far and endlessly echoing.

presets.name: Dream inside a dream
presets.about: Slowed words with ghostly backwards swells and a doubled chorus, a dream folding in on itself.

presets.name: Lullaby from the moon
presets.about: Speech softly tuned into a lullaby, floating above you on a warm summer night.

presets.name: Sleepwalker murmuring
presets.about: A drowsy murmur that wanders away from you down a dark hallway.

presets.name: Trapped in an hourglass
presets.about: A tiny voice in a glass hourglass, its words trickling away like grains of sand.

presets.name: Funk synth talk box lead
presets.about: A fat, slightly driven funk synth slides after your voice on dorian notes while your mouth shapes every word.

presets.name: Talk box on a chord
presets.about: A lush minor seventh chord says your words, held under every syllable.

presets.name: Talk box chord changes
presets.about: Your words ride a slow loop of jazzy ninth chords that change every bar.

presets.name: Talk box funk riff with echo
presets.about: A busy funk riff plays in time while your mouth turns it into words, with an echo on the off beats.

presets.name: Talk box arpeggio
presets.about: A bright arpeggio climbs a major chord in time, bouncing between your ears as you talk.

presets.name: Blues fuzz guitar talk box
presets.about: A fuzzed-out guitar sings your words on blues notes, with a quick slap of echo right behind it.

presets.name: Church organ talk box
presets.about: A big low organ chord speaks your words and rings around the stone walls of a church.

presets.name: Eight-bit talk box
presets.about: A buzzing game console lead runs a quick arpeggio while your mouth makes the words.

presets.name: Bass talk box
presets.about: A round synth bass walks under your words, low and squashed like a funk record.

presets.name: Square lead talk box
presets.about: A hollow square lead glides high between the notes of a major scale as you speak.

presets.name: Fuzz power chord talk box
presets.about: A low, roaring guitar power chord is shaped into your words in a garage.

presets.name: Talk box on one note
presets.about: One deep held synth note mouths your words like a droning robot singer.

presets.name: Vocoder synth lead
presets.about: The classic robot synth voice: a bright saw lead plays your words on one note.

presets.name: Vocoder strings
presets.about: A wide string-machine chord sings your words in a soft shimmering hall.

presets.name: Vocoder choir pad
presets.about: A choir of synthetic voices sings your words on a floating suspended chord.

presets.name: Vocoder organ
presets.about: A churchy organ seventh chord says your words, swirling slowly in a rotating speaker.

presets.name: Power chord robot vocoder
presets.about: A low hollow power chord speaks for you with a little grit, like an arena robot.

presets.name: Wide breath vocoder
presets.about: Your words carved out of rushing noise and spread wide, a breathy machine whisper with no pitch at all.

presets.name: Gated pulse vocoder
presets.about: A thin pulse chord plays your words chopped into a trance rhythm.

presets.name: Big open chord vocoder
presets.about: A huge low stack of detuned saws sings your words like a film score.

presets.name: Deep octave vocoder
presets.about: A rumbling saw in low octaves, few bands and slow, like a giant speaking machine.

presets.name: Eight-band retro vocoder
presets.about: An early boxy vocoder with only eight bands: chunky, buzzy and only just readable.

presets.name: Crisp hi-fi vocoder
presets.about: Sixty-four bands and sharp consonants: a clean modern vocoder on a bright major chord.

presets.name: Wind vocoder
presets.about: The wind itself howls your words, on a cold hilltop.

presets.name: Spoken by the rain
presets.about: Falling rain forms your words, drop by drop, out in a downpour.

presets.name: Spoken by a crowd
presets.about: The murmur of a crowded hall shapes itself into your words.

presets.name: Half you, half thunder
presets.about: Your voice poured into rolling thunder, half words and half storm.

presets.name: Backwards gong swell
presets.about: Your words ring through a big gong, each one swelling in backwards before it lands.

presets.name: Rain that swells with your words
presets.about: Rain grows heavier while you speak and eases off in every pause.

presets.name: Ring-modulated by an engine
presets.about: An idling engine throbs through your voice, then a ring of metal clangs on top.

presets.name: Words roared by a bonfire
presets.about: Crackling flames roar your words beside a big bonfire.

presets.name: Spoken by the waves
presets.about: Breaking waves wash in and out in the shape of your words on a beach.

presets.name: Words made of organ
presets.about: A pipe organ chord is sculpted into your words, then fills a stone church.

presets.name: Words rung on bells
presets.about: A peal of bells shapes itself into each word and rings on after.

presets.name: Engine that runs while you talk
presets.about: A rumbling motor starts up with every phrase and cuts out when you stop.

presets.name: Warm pad that swells with you
presets.about: A soft synth pad blooms behind your voice as you speak and fades in the gaps.

presets.name: Drone that bows to your voice
presets.about: A low drone hums all the time and dips politely under every word you say.

presets.name: Wind harp on a hilltop
presets.about: Wind blows through your words and across harp strings tuned to an open chord, so the gusts sing.

presets.name: Half you, half bells
presets.about: Your voice and a ring of bells share one shape, so the bells seem to breathe.

presets.name: Talk box on your own sound
presets.about: Give it any recording and your mouth shapes it into words, like a talk box.

presets.name: Vocoder on your own sound
presets.about: Any sound you give it plays your words, through a forty-band vocoder.

presets.name: Your words made of your sound
presets.about: Your words spoken by the sound you choose, a song, a dog, a blender, anything.

presets.name: Voice poured into your sound
presets.about: Your voice rings through the sound you pick, as if it had its own body.

presets.name: Your sound swells as you talk
presets.about: The sound you pick rises while you talk and sinks in every pause.

presets.name: Half you, half your sound
presets.about: Your voice and the sound you choose melt into one, shaped by both.

presets.name: Ring-modulated by your sound
presets.about: Your voice multiplied by the sound you choose, a clanging metallic mash of both.

presets.name: Church bells
presets.about: Every word strikes a big bronze bell that hums on into a stone church.

presets.name: Glass harmonica
presets.about: Your voice rubs the rims of singing glasses, pure and wavering, in a soft room.

presets.name: Low singing bowl
presets.about: A big, low brass singing bowl hums and beats slowly under every word you say.

presets.name: Struck temple gong
presets.about: Each syllable hits a deep gong that shimmers out across a cathedral.

presets.name: Wind chimes on the porch
presets.about: Metal chimes tinkle with your words and drift side to side in a breeze.

presets.name: Steel drum
presets.about: Bright steel pan notes ring out on every word with a quick slap of echo.

presets.name: Music box
presets.about: Tiny steel tines plink high along with your voice inside a little wooden box.

presets.name: Theatre thunder sheet
presets.about: A huge stage thunder sheet rumbles and clangs with each word, a slow swirl running through it.

presets.name: Handbell choir
presets.about: A table of small high bells rung by several hands every time you speak.

presets.name: Ice crystal chimes
presets.about: Only the brightest notes of your voice freeze into ringing ice that rises in a shimmer.

presets.name: Ringing chord comb
presets.about: Your voice is tuned through a ringing major chord, a metallic choir in a soft hall.

presets.name: Wooden marimba bars
presets.about: Warm wooden bars knock and hum under every syllable you speak.

presets.name: Hollow wooden box drum
presets.about: You talk into a box drum and every word thumps its hollow wooden body.

presets.name: Long hollow tube
presets.about: Your voice hoots down a long open pipe that hums its own low notes.

presets.name: Blowing across a bottle
presets.about: Your words become breath whistling over the neck of a glass bottle.

presets.name: Didgeridoo-like drone
presets.about: A deep buzzing drone through a long wooden tube, your words riding on top.

presets.name: Wooden tongue drum
presets.about: Low round wooden tongues ring softly with your words in a big quiet room.

presets.name: Plucked harp strings
presets.about: High harp strings are plucked with every word and ring along with your voice.

presets.name: Sitar-like buzzing strings
presets.about: Drone strings buzz against a curved bridge and shimmer around your voice.

presets.name: Concert grand, pedal down
presets.about: You talk into a concert grand with the sustain pedal held, and its low strings ring back in the hall.

presets.name: Dark minor harp
presets.about: Low, soft-plucked minor strings follow every word like a sad ballad.

presets.name: Open fifths drone strings
presets.about: Low open fifths ring on and on behind you and rise in a heavenly shimmer.

presets.name: Bright zither
presets.about: Sharp high strings snap with a hard pick and a little bridge buzz on every syllable.

presets.name: Twelve-string shimmer
presets.about: Octave strings strummed in pairs, wide and chorused like a jangly guitar.

presets.name: Minor seventh strings
presets.about: A mellow jazzy minor seventh chord rings and trembles under your words.

presets.name: Bowed minor strings
presets.about: A section of bowed strings swells along with you on a minor chord, with gentle vibrato.

presets.name: Spooky cluster harp
presets.about: Clashing harp strings in a tight cluster jangle eerily after every word.

presets.name: Organ through a rotating speaker
presets.about: A drawbar organ plays your words while the speaker cabinet spins up to full speed.

presets.name: Cathedral pipe organ
presets.about: A huge low organ chord speaks your words and rolls around a cathedral.

presets.name: Fairground organ
presets.about: A bright wheezing band organ plays your words at a busy fair at night.

presets.name: Electric piano dream
presets.about: Soft electric piano tines ring with your voice, wobbling gently from ear to ear.

presets.name: Toy piano
presets.about: Plinky little piano notes ring out of a tiny plastic speaker.

presets.name: Wheezy squeezebox
presets.about: A reedy accordion-like chord breathes in and out as it says your words.

presets.name: Bass synth
presets.about: A deep filtered saw bass plays your words like a low robot groove.

presets.name: Theremin-like glide
presets.about: A thin eerie tone swoops and wavers along with the tune of your voice.

presets.name: Trance supersaw lead
presets.about: Huge detuned saws say your words on the offbeat with echoes trailing behind.

presets.name: Squelchy acid bass
presets.about: A rubbery low saw squelches and squeals as a filter opens on your loud words.

presets.name: Synth brass stabs
presets.about: Punchy saw-brass power chords stab out each word with a gated room burst.

presets.name: Wobbling bass synth
presets.about: A low octave saw bass wobbles as a resonant filter swings open and shut.

presets.name: Arcade arpeggio singer
presets.about: Your speech races up and down a chord in crunchy four-bit sound, like an old arcade tune.

presets.name: Chip lead that follows you
presets.about: A buzzy game-console pulse sings your tune on a major scale, then gets crunched.

presets.name: Singing musical saw
presets.about: A pure bending tone slides between every note you speak with a wide, weepy vibrato.

presets.name: Frozen voice pad
presets.about: Moments of your voice are caught and held ringing into a soft frozen pad.

presets.name: Endless ambient pad
presets.about: Your words stretched four times longer into a slow, glowing cloud of sound.

presets.name: Four-part choir of you
presets.about: Four extra singers made from your voice fill out a big chord in a stone church.

presets.name: Angel pad shimmer
presets.about: Your voice rises in octaves and fifths into a smeared, heavenly halo.

presets.name: Humming drone pad
presets.about: Your voice tuned to one low note and smeared into a humming drone.

presets.name: Grain cloud choir
presets.about: Your voice scattered into long overlapping grains that float like a soft choir.

presets.name: Kazoo band
presets.about: A whole buzzing kazoo band plays along with you in the living room.

presets.name: Comb and paper busker
presets.about: Tissue paper on a comb buzzes out your tune on a street corner while the city goes by.

presets.name: Big and small kazoo duet
presets.about: A tuba-sized kazoo and a tiny one blart out your words together, an octave apart.

presets.name: Droning mouth harp
presets.about: A twangy jaw harp holds one droning note and boings and wahs through everything you say.

presets.name: Twangy rubber band
presets.about: Low slack strings boing and wobble like a rubber band plucked with every word.

presets.name: Jug band blower
presets.about: Your buzzing lips boom into a big clay jug like an old porch band.

presets.name: Warm master
presets.about: Rounds off the top, fills out the bottom and adds a little tape warmth to any song or voice.

presets.name: Bright master
presets.about: Lifts the top end and the presence so every word and cymbal sparkles, without getting thin.

presets.name: Loud modern master
presets.about: A punchy smile of an EQ, tape heat, extra width and a hard limiter, squeezed loud like a new pop single.

presets.name: Gentle glue
presets.about: A slow, soft compressor and a touch of width that pull a mix together without anyone noticing.

presets.name: Shape-shifting voice

presets.name: Vowel carousel
presets.about: Your mouth slowly turns through every vowel while the words go on.

presets.name: Every vowel wrong
presets.about: Vowels jump to random shapes many times a second, garbling every word.

presets.name: Voice with two throats
presets.about: One throat two octaves down and another an octave up, talking together.

presets.name: Sinking through the floor
presets.about: Your voice slides down two octaves while sinking below you.

presets.name: Rising into the sky
presets.about: Your voice climbs higher and higher, floating up over your head.

presets.name: Speech on a staircase of notes
presets.about: Your words hop between random notes of a dreamy scale, twelve a second.

presets.name: Rubber throat
presets.about: A throat that slowly stretches into a big wide wow and back.

presets.name: Clean up my recording
presets.about: One tap for a home recording: hum, hiss, clicks and harsh s sounds out, a gentle polish and steadier level.

presets.name: Remove mains hum
presets.about: Notches out the 50 or 60 hertz hum and its harmonics, and trims the rumble underneath.

presets.name: Remove buzz from lights and cables
presets.about: Takes out a raspy electrical buzz, many harmonics deep, and softens the fizzy top it leaves.

presets.name: Reduce background noise, strongly
presets.about: Deep noise reduction and quiet pauses, with a lift in presence to win back the clarity.

presets.name: Noise that comes and goes
presets.about: Keeps listening for traffic, rain or a changing room and removes it as it shifts.

presets.name: Fan and air conditioner noise
presets.about: Removes the steady roar of a fan or air conditioner and the low drone under it.

presets.name: Old tape hiss removed
presets.about: Takes the hiss off an old cassette or reel transfer, rolls off the fizzy top and gives back some body.

presets.name: Noisy cafe interview
presets.about: Pulls a voice out of cafe chatter: changing noise removed, pauses quieted, words pushed forward.

presets.name: Wind noise on an outdoor mic
presets.about: A steep low cut for the wind rumble and thumps of a recording made outside, then the gusty noise cleared.

presets.name: Tame a roomy echo
presets.about: Shortens the room ringing after each word and cuts the hollow boxiness and honk of a bare room.

presets.name: Reduce background noise, gently
presets.about: A light touch of noise reduction and slightly quieter pauses that never sounds processed.

presets.name: Record crackle removed
presets.about: Fills in record ticks, trims the turntable rumble and surface hiss, and brings the voice forward.

presets.name: Plosive pops softened
presets.about: Softens the bumps of p and b sounds hitting the mic with a steep low cut and a very fast catch.

presets.name: Mouth clicks and lip smacks
presets.about: Fills in mouth clicks and lip smacks and smooths the sticky band they live in.

presets.name: Tame harsh s sounds
presets.about: Turns down only the hiss of s and sh sounds, so they stop stabbing without a lisp.

presets.name: Strong de-ess for bright mics
presets.about: A deep, wide de-ess from 5 kilohertz up and a notch on the whistle band, for mics that make every s whistle.

presets.name: Soft s sounds for whispers
presets.about: A lower, gentler de-ess and a slightly darker tone for quiet, breathy narration.

presets.name: Hear what the de-esser takes
presets.about: Plays only the hiss the de-esser removes, so you can hear whether it is catching the right sounds.

presets.name: Bright voice, smooth s sounds
presets.about: Tips your whole voice brighter with sparkle on top, then keeps the s sounds from getting sharp.

presets.name: Headset harshness fix
presets.about: Takes the piercing edge off a gaming or office headset mic, calms its s sounds and steadies the level.

presets.name: Breath softener
presets.about: Turns breaths and little noises between words down a bit without cutting them out.

presets.name: Keyboard clicks under your voice
presets.about: Picks out keyboard and mouse clicks between and under your words, and quiets the gaps.

presets.name: Warmth boost
presets.about: A gentle lift in the chest of your voice and a softer top for a fuller, cosier sound.

presets.name: Presence boost
presets.about: Lifts the consonant band so your words cut through and sound closer.

presets.name: Air on top
presets.about: A silky high shelf that adds breath and sparkle above the voice.

presets.name: Less boom underneath
presets.about: Clears out a boomy bottom end so the voice sits lighter and cleaner.

presets.name: De-mud at 250 hertz
presets.about: A deep dip in the muddy low-mids, the most common fix for a cloudy voice.

presets.name: Less boxy, 500 hertz
presets.about: Cuts the cardboard-box honk of a small room or a cheap mic.

presets.name: Less nasal honk
presets.about: A narrow cut around 1 kilohertz that takes the nasal honk out of a voice.

presets.name: Darker for a harsh mic
presets.about: Tips the whole voice darker and rounder when a mic sounds edgy or brittle.

presets.name: Brighter for a dull mic
presets.about: Tips the whole voice brighter when a recording sounds muffled or far away.

presets.name: Thin recording warm-up
presets.about: Puts real body back into a thin, weedy recording with a big low lift and a touch of tape.

presets.name: Radio mid boost
presets.about: Pushes the middle of the voice forward, the way radio voices cut through a car speaker.

presets.name: Too close to the mic
presets.about: Undoes the boomy chest and spitty s sounds of talking right on the mic, and steps you back a little.

presets.name: Ribbon mic smoothness
presets.about: The soft, rounded top and gentle weight of a classic ribbon microphone.

presets.name: Vintage dynamic mic
presets.about: A stage mic sound: trimmed lows, a firm upper-middle peak and a top that stops short.

presets.name: Extra clear speech
presets.about: Strips the low rumble, lifts the consonants and evens the level so every word is easy to follow.

presets.name: Gentle compression
presets.about: A light, slow touch that smooths the level without anyone hearing it work.

presets.name: Firm voiceover compression
presets.about: A tighter hold on your level for voiceover and narration that sits steady in a mix.

presets.name: Heavy squash
presets.about: Crushes the level flat with a fast, hard compressor, every breath and word the same size.

presets.name: Parallel punch
presets.about: A crushed copy blended under your natural voice for density that keeps its life.

presets.name: Slow levelling
presets.about: A slow, soft-kneed leveller that rides loud and quiet sentences toward each other.

presets.name: Whisper booster
presets.about: Brings quiet, soft-spoken words right up, adds warmth to the breath and softens the hiss of a whisper.

presets.name: Shout-proof mic
presets.about: Leaves normal talking alone and grabs sudden loud words and laughs before they overload.

presets.name: Broadcast loud
presets.about: The full on-air squeeze: four-band compression and a limiter for a loud, dense voice.

presets.name: Gentle podcast processor
presets.about: A light multiband polish that evens the level for a lean, clear and natural podcast voice.

presets.name: Podcast finish, full chain
presets.about: Everything a podcast voice needs in order: noise, clicks, s sounds and mud out, then a warm, close broadcast finish.

presets.name: Warm radio voice
presets.about: A deep, smooth, close radio sound with a warm chest and a soft top.

presets.name: Audiobook, clean and even
presets.about: A transparent narration chain: quiet floor, no clicks, soft s sounds and a slow, even level.

presets.name: Commercial voiceover, bright
presets.about: A loud, crisp, airy advert finish that jumps out of a mix.

presets.name: Deep narration
presets.about: A weighty, warm narration sound: a fuller chest, a slightly bigger body and a steady level.

presets.name: Phone recording made better
presets.about: Rebuilds the missing chest and top of a phone voice memo and takes the honk out of the middle.

presets.name: Telephone to studio
presets.about: A strong rescue for a call recording: big low and high shelves, harmonics to fill the gaps, soft s sounds.

presets.name: Laptop mic rescue
presets.about: Fixes a laptop's built-in mic: fan noise down, boxy middle cut, words lifted forward.

presets.name: Earbud mic rescue
presets.about: Fills out the thin, papery sound of an earbud microphone and calms its harsh middle.

presets.name: Far from the mic rescue
presets.about: Brings a voice recorded across the room closer: room tails cut, chest warmth back, mud out, presence up.

presets.name: Voice memo made better
presets.about: Tidies a quick voice memo: noise learned as it goes, rumble and honk cut, body added and a gentle podcast polish.

presets.name: Video voiceover, clear and punchy
presets.about: A close, forward, tightly levelled voice that stays clear over music and sound effects.

presets.name: Livestream mic chain
presets.about: A quick live-friendly chain: quiet pauses, firm level, polish and soft s sounds.

presets.name: Collar mic made brighter
presets.about: Opens up a clip-on mic buried under clothing: chesty boom down, clarity and air back on top.

presets.name: Tighten pauses
presets.about: Shortens long pauses to a comfortable breath so the read keeps moving.

presets.name: Tighten pauses hard
presets.about: Cuts every gap down to a sliver for a fast, tightly edited read.

presets.name: Slow down clearly
presets.about: Plays your speech a bit slower without changing your pitch, for easier listening.

presets.name: Slow down a lot for learning
presets.about: Much slower speech at your own pitch, for transcribing or learning words.

presets.name: Speed up a little
presets.about: Nudges the pace up a touch without changing your pitch, to tighten a slow read.

presets.name: Fast listening speed
presets.about: Half again as fast at your own pitch, for skimming long recordings.

presets.name: Tight radio edit
presets.about: Pauses trimmed, pace nudged up and a light broadcast squeeze, like a radio producer's edit.

presets.name: A touch of room
presets.about: A little natural living-room air behind a very dry voice, so it sounds less boxed in.

presets.name: Small vocal booth
presets.about: The tight, padded sound of a small recording booth around your voice.

presets.name: Studio plate for voice
presets.about: A short, bright plate reverb that adds polish without pushing the voice back.

presets.name: Warm hall for narration
presets.about: A soft, dark hall tail for storytelling and trailers, kept low so words stay clear.

presets.name: Wide stereo double
presets.about: Two more takes of your voice, a hair late and off pitch, spread wide around the first.

presets.name: Stereo spread, mono safe
presets.about: Spreads a mono voice into gentle stereo that still sounds right on one speaker.

presets.name: Tape warmth
presets.about: The soft squash, rounded highs and low bump of slow analogue tape: darker, rounder and warmer.

presets.name: Tube preamp warmth
presets.about: A valve glow blended under your voice: richer harmonics with a brighter, forward edge.

presets.name: Console glue
presets.about: Mixing desk colour: a little transformer grit, a forward middle and slow compression that pulls it together.

presets.name: A touch deeper
presets.about: Lowers your voice by one semitone with a slightly bigger body, still clearly you.

presets.name: A touch lighter
presets.about: Lifts your voice by one semitone with a little more brightness, for a fresher read.

presets.name: Fuller timbre, same pitch
presets.about: Keeps your note exactly but gives your voice a larger, chestier body.

presets.name: Leaner timbre, same pitch
presets.about: Keeps your note exactly but gives your voice a slimmer, lighter body.

presets.name: Calmer, steadier melody
presets.about: Gently evens out the ups and downs of your pitch and level for a calm, measured read.

beds.name: Roaring blaze
beds.about: A big bonfire roaring and flaring, crackling loudly all across, timbers collapsing into it.

beds.name: Blizzard
beds.about: A howling snowstorm: freezing gusts full of hissing, ticking snow, out in it or safe inside a cabin.

beds.name: Motor boat
beds.about: Out on the water in a motor boat: the engine, the hull slapping the waves and the wash along the side.

beds.name: City bus
beds.about: Riding a city bus: the diesel growling at the back, stops, hissing doors and brakes, rattling windows.

beds.name: Coffee shop
beds.about: A busy coffee shop: chatter at the tables, cups and spoons clinking, the espresso machine hissing.

beds.name: Campfire
beds.about: A wood campfire crackling and popping, flames softly roaring, logs settling now and then.

beds.name: Car on the highway
beds.about: Riding in a car at highway speed: tyre roar, wind, the engine, and trucks passing by.

beds.name: Car in the rain
beds.about: Inside a car in the rain: drumming on the roof, drops on the windscreen, wipers swishing and the heater fan.

beds.name: Carnival
beds.about: A fairground at night: a band organ playing far off, crowd chatter, game bells, rides rumbling and distant screams.

beds.name: Casino floor
beds.about: A casino floor: slot machines chiming, coins and chips clattering, a roulette wheel, and a cheer from a table.

beds.name: Dripping cave
beds.about: Deep in a cave: water dripping into pools from several places, each with its own note, echoing in the dark.

beds.name: City street
beds.about: A busy city sidewalk: cars swishing past, horns, a far-off siren, and people walking by.

beds.name: Ticking clock
beds.about: A clock ticking in a quiet room, from a pocket watch to a tall case clock that can strike the hour.

beds.name: Construction site
beds.about: A building site: a jackhammer, hammering, a circular saw, a diesel digger and a reversing beeper.

beds.name: Babbling creek
beds.about: A shallow creek close by, gurgling and bubbling over the stones in several places.

beds.name: Desert wind
beds.about: Hot dry wind across open sand, the grains hissing in every gust, with the odd low hum of a singing dune if you like.

beds.name: Dungeon
beds.about: Deep under a castle: water dripping on stone, chains shifting, far groans and an iron door.

beds.name: Eerie wavering whine
beds.about: The wavering electric whine of old horror and space films: ghostly swoops, a strange tune or a trembling note.

beds.name: Engine room
beds.about: Deep in an engine room: huge machinery pounding in a steel hall, steam hissing, a pump and clanking tools.

beds.name: Factory floor
beds.about: A factory floor: a pounding press, a rattling conveyor, motors humming, and bursts of compressed air.

beds.name: Farmyard morning
beds.about: Early morning on a farm: roosters crowing, hens clucking nearby, sparrows, doves, a far cow.

beds.name: Fireplace
beds.about: A log fire in the hearth of a quiet room, crackling gently, the chimney drawing, logs shifting on the grate.

beds.name: Forest birds
beds.about: A spring wood full of birdsong: singers near and far, soft chips, a far dove, wind in the leaves.

beds.name: Fountain
beds.about: A fountain splashing and sparkling into its stone basin, in a quiet garden or a town square.

beds.name: Refrigerator hum
beds.about: A refrigerator humming in a quiet kitchen at night, with clicks, gurgles and the odd drop of ice.

beds.name: Frog pond
beds.about: A spring pond after dark: peepers ringing, trilling toads, twangy frogs, and the odd splash.

beds.name: Graveyard at night
beds.about: An old graveyard after dark: wind in bare trees, crickets, an owl, a far bell and a creaking iron gate.

beds.name: Hail
beds.about: Hailstones clattering and bouncing on the ground, a deck, a window, a tin roof or a car.

beds.name: Haunted house
beds.about: An old house at night: creaking doors and floors, steps upstairs, wind at the windows and far-off moans.

beds.name: Heartbeat
beds.about: A heartbeat, lub-dub, steady or racing or skipping, heard from inside, on a chest or under the floor.

beds.name: Helicopter cabin
beds.about: Inside a helicopter in flight: the deep rotor thump, the turbine whine, the gearbox and rushing wind.

beds.name: Hospital ward
beds.about: A hospital ward: a heart monitor beeping, soft footsteps, a hushed nurses station and a distant page.

beds.name: Jungle by day
beds.about: A steamy rainforest by day: strange bird calls, whooping far off, winding cicadas, frogs and drips.

beds.name: Restaurant kitchen
beds.about: A restaurant kitchen at full tilt: sizzling pans, chopping, clanging pots, the hood fan and shouted orders.

beds.name: Laundromat
beds.about: A laundromat: washers sloshing, dryers tumbling with buttons ticking, a spin cycle whining, coins and buzzers.

beds.name: Library
beds.about: A quiet library: soft air, pages turning, a whisper now and then, and footsteps on carpet.

beds.name: Meadow at dawn
beds.about: First light in an open meadow: a skylark high above, sweet whistles in the grass, doves far off.

beds.name: Mountain top
beds.about: A windy summit: gusts roaring past your ears, whistling rocks, a hawk crying far below, echoes.

beds.name: Broken music box
beds.about: An old music box playing a sad little waltz, out of tune, missing notes, running down and wound again.

beds.name: Night crickets
beds.about: A warm summer night: crickets near and far, katydids answering each other, a still breeze.

beds.name: Ocean waves
beds.about: Waves rolling onto a beach, crashing, washing up the sand and fizzing back, from calm lapping to big surf.

beds.name: Office
beds.about: An open office: air conditioning, keyboards clicking, phones ringing far off, a printer and quiet talk.

beds.name: Owls in the woods
beds.about: Dark woods at night: owls hooting and answering, a slow wind in the trees, a few insects.

beds.name: Telephone line
beds.about: An old phone line: a dial tone, ringing or busy signal, with hiss, hum, clicks and faint crosstalk.

beds.name: Radio static
beds.about: A radio between stations: hiss and crackle, whistling carriers and faded fragments of far stations.

beds.name: Rain gutter
beds.about: Rain running along the gutter, gurgling down the pipe and pouring out at the bottom.

beds.name: Rain on a tin roof
beds.about: Under a metal roof while rain drums and pings on it, with gutter drips outside.

beds.name: Rain on a tent
beds.about: Camping in the rain: drops patter and thump on the tent fabric, with bigger drips falling from the trees.

beds.name: Rain on a window
beds.about: Indoors by a window while rain taps the glass, runs off the frame and trickles down the gutter outside.

beds.name: Rain
beds.about: Steady rain, close enough to hear the drops, on the ground, puddles and leaves, or a surface you pick.

beds.name: Rainforest at night
beds.about: A tropical rainforest after dark: a wall of insects, two-note tree frogs, drips, a lonely night bird.

beds.name: River
beds.about: A wide river flowing past, from a smooth steady current to churning rapids.

beds.name: Rocket launch
beds.about: A rocket launch: ignition, a crackling roar building to full thrust, then climbing away into the sky.

beds.name: Sailboat
beds.about: Aboard a sailboat: wind in the rigging, a flapping sail, creaking lines, a halyard tinking and water at the hull.

beds.name: School hallway
beds.about: A school hallway between classes: kids chattering, lockers slamming, sneakers squeaking, and the bell.

beds.name: Seagulls in a harbor
beds.about: A small harbor: gulls calling and laughing, water lapping, rigging clinking, a bell buoy far out.

beds.name: Server room
beds.about: A server room: a wall of fans roaring, air handlers rumbling, a faint electrical hum and drive clicks.

beds.name: Waves on rocks
beds.about: Sea waves booming against rocks, spray falling back in a shower of drops and water gurgling out of the cracks.

beds.name: Spaceship bridge
beds.about: On the bridge of a starship: a deep engine drone, air humming, consoles chirping and beeping.

beds.name: Stadium crowd
beds.about: A big stadium crowd: a roaring murmur that swells, cheers, applause, whistles and chants.

beds.name: Thunderstorm
beds.about: Heavy rain and gusty wind with thunder, cracking overhead or rumbling far away.

beds.name: Submarine
beds.about: Inside a submarine: the low hum of the boat, sonar pings ringing into the deep, the hull groaning.

beds.name: Subway car
beds.about: Inside an underground train: tunnel roar, motors whining up and down, squealing curves and door chimes.

beds.name: Subway platform
beds.about: An underground platform: trains rumble in and out, doors chime, announcements echo off the tiles.

beds.name: Summer field
beds.about: A hot summer field: cicadas swelling in the trees, grasshoppers, bees buzzing past, a warm breeze.

beds.name: Swamp at night
beds.about: A warm swamp after dark: deep frogs booming, twangs and clicks, rasping insects, bubbling mud.

beds.name: Crackling torch
beds.about: A burning torch fluttering and spitting, drips of burning pitch hissing out on the floor.

beds.name: Train ride
beds.about: Inside a train car: clickety-clack over the rails, the rumble of the wheels and a horn far ahead.

beds.name: TV static
beds.about: An old tube television tuned to nothing: the hiss of snow, the high whine and a buzz of sync.

beds.name: Underwater
beds.about: Under the sea: muffled pressure and swells, a crackling reef all round, and a diver breathing out streams of bubbles.

beds.name: Waterfall
beds.about: The roar of a waterfall pouring into its pool, with drifting spray, from a small cascade to huge falls.

beds.name: Howling wind
beds.about: Wind moaning and howling round the house in long gusts, with windows rattling when it blows hardest.

beds.name: Wind in the trees
beds.about: A breeze moving through the trees, leaves rustling as each gust passes from one tree to the next.

beds.name: Wind
beds.about: Open-air wind that rises and falls in gusts, with a thin whistle and a low rumble in the strong ones.

beds.name: Wolves far off
beds.about: A cold night: a wolf pack howling across the valley, echoing off the far hills, wind in the dark.
